items.topic: EIP-8487：分开执行额度和计费额度
items.title: EIPs PR #12637：Separate execution credits and billing credits
items.note: 22:58 提交。两个计数器都从 `tx.gasLimit` 初始化：credits 用旧 gas 表，决定 EVM 可见的执行额度（包括 CALL 和合约创建）；billing 用新 gas 表，决定交易费。billing 不足时整笔交易中止且不可捕获，即使 credits 还有剩余。
items.title_en: EIPs PR #12637: Separate execution credits and billing credits
items.note_en: Opened at 22:58. Both counters start from `tx.gasLimit`: credits use the legacy schedule and govern EVM-visible execution allowances (including CALL and contract creation); billing uses the new schedule and sets the transaction fee. If billing runs out, the whole transaction aborts and the abort cannot be caught, even if credits remain.
items.topic_en: EIP-8487: separate execution credits and billing credits

items.topic: ETH 作为价值储存，而不是烧费代币
items.title: Vitalik：为什么“ETH 作为价值储存”比“ETH 作为烧费代币”更值得聚焦
items.note: 19:06，三条理由：烧费叙事从来没有看上去那么强；为烧费优化会要求牺牲去中心化和抗捕获（要撑起约 2,700 亿美元市值，以太坊得变成世界级的收费平台）；为价值储存优化与去中心化和 CROPS 一致。
items.title_en: Vitalik: why "ETH as store of value" makes more sense to focus on than "ETH as fee-burning token"
items.note_en: 19:06. Three reasons: the fee-burning story was never as strong as it looked; optimizing for fee burning would require compromising decentralization and capture resistance (to justify a market cap of about $270 billion, Ethereum would essentially have to act as a world-scale fee platform); and optimizing for store of value is aligned with decentralization and CROPS.
items.topic_en: ETH as a store of value, not a fee-burning token

items.note: （X 文章 22:45）：Devcon L1 研发日讨论 Glamsterdam、Hegotá、I-star；后量子是最重要的话题（Justin Drake 介绍 2028 年全面抗量子路线）；FCR 把 L1 到 L2 和交易所的入金时间降到 12 到 24 秒，Gnosis 采用约一个月已为用户省下 12 天以上的等待，周报引用 Quicknode 11-04 的公告：FCR beta 已对其所有客户开放，其他 RPC 服务商也已支持。怎么用：在 Quicknode 主网端点开启 FCR，继续调用 `safe` 标签，无需改代码。
items.title_en: Ethlabs week 20 update
items.note_en: (X article at 22:45): the Devcon L1 R&D days covered Glamsterdam, Hegotá and I-star; post-quantum was the most important topic (Justin Drake presented the roadmap to be fully quantum-secure by 2028); FCR cuts deposit times from L1 to L2s and exchanges to 12 to 24 seconds, and Gnosis, which adopted it about a month ago, has saved its users more than 12 days of waiting. The update cites Quicknode's 11-04 announcement that the FCR beta is open to all its customers, and other RPC providers already support it. How to use it: enable FCR on a Quicknode mainnet endpoint and keep calling the `safe` tag, with no code changes.

summary_en: Core developers argued on X all day about whether Glamsterdam's gas repricing will break deployed contracts. One side holds that you should never break things that work; the other says that would mean the gas schedule can never change. A targeted proposal, EIP-8487, appeared the same day: the old gas schedule governs execution and the new one governs billing. Vitalik explained at length why ETH should focus on being a store of value rather than a fee-burning token. The Ethlabs week 20 update reports that Quicknode now supports FCR.
